sourceIdentity: Each evidence JSON includes Git revision, dirty status and SHA-256 of verification scripts, fixtures, and Node entrypoints; resource hashes bind the tested compiler/debugger modules.
enhancements: shadow minimal regression additionally checks outer value=7 and interpreter exit=0
output flood requires exactly three lines / 63 complete UTF-8 bytes under the 64-byte limit
loop-header regression also requires interpreter exit=0
limitations: Desktop Node only; no real iPad, browser UI, installation or complete offline cold-start acceptance.
Independent harness uses real CompilerProbe output and a development BuildManifest wrapper; separate full CompilerAdapter tests remain necessary.
Five restart rounds reuse one compiled c-core artifact; edited-source recompilation is a separate check.
Fixture manifest checkpoints not visited by the runner remain unverified.
